title: poa deminuta
intro: Poa deminuta, commonly known as Blue Fescue Grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa deminuta include its ability to soothe skin irritations and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and properties.
